### Jehoshaphat and Dangerous Naiveté
Author: Grace to You
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B160708/jehoshaphat-and-dangerous-naivete
Passage: 2 Chronicles 18:1
Points:
- Even godly, mature believers are vulnerable to poor discernment and foolish partnerships.
- Jehoshaphat's marriage alliance with wicked King Ahab stemmed from naive compromise rather than open rebellion.
- Unholy associations bring devastating long-term consequences that can unravel a godly legacy across generations.
- Christians must take seriously biblical commands against being unequally yoked with worldly influences.
- Parents and church leaders must act as vigilant gatekeepers guarding against false teaching and unrighteous compromise.
